GR·3S320 FIRSTAMENDMENT TOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAND EASEMENT AGREEMENT THIS FIRST AMENDMENTTOZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “First Amendment") is made as of June 18, 2021 by and between UNIVERSITY STONE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Owner”), having an address c/o King Rook Capital LLC, 111 Broadway, Suite 1703, New York, New York 10006, Attention: David Issroff , and 64 UNIVERSITY PLACE LLC, a New York limited liability company,c/o Argo Real Estate LLC and Bsafal Inc, 50 W 17th Street, 6th floor,New York,New York 10010, Attention: Mark Moskowitz and Ameesh Agarwal ("Developer"). RECITALS A. Owner, in its capacity as the owner of certain land located in the City, County and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, known as 70 University Place and designated as Block 568, Lot 20 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the“Tax Map") and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit A, annexed hereto and made a part hereof (Lot 20"); and (y) Developer, in its capacity as the owner of certain land located in the City, County and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, known as 64 University Place and designated as Lot Block 568, Lot 21 on the Tax Map and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit B,annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Lot 21"), executed a certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement (the “ExistingZLDA")dated as of November18,2019 and recorded in the Office of the CityRegister of the City of New York ("City Register") as CRFN: 2019000384718 pursuant to which, inter ZLDA). B． Owner and Developer acknowledged and agreed in the Existing ZLDA that (i) certain of the Reserved Unutilized Development Rights (as defined in the Existing ZLDA) are to be conveyed by Owner to Developer at the Supplemental Closing pursuant to that certain Development Rights Purchase and Sale Agreement dated as of October 18, 2019 between Owner and Developer, as amended by that certain Amendment to Development Rights Purchase and Sale Agreement dated July 9, 2020 between Owner and Developer (the “Purchase Agreement"), and (i) in accordance with the Purchase Agreement, at the Supplemental Closing, Developer and Owner will execute, acknowledge and cause to be recorded with the City Register, the ZLDA Amendment (as defined in thePurchase Agreement). C. The Supplemental Closing has now occurred, and Owner and Developer seek to amend the Existing ZLDA, on the terms and conditions set forth in this Amendment, to memorialize the conveyance of the Additional Development Rights (as defined in the Purchase Agreement) in respect of the Supplemental Closing. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: NATIONALGRANITE TITLE 2392707v2 155NMAINSTREET HF 13840656v.6 NEWCITY,NY10956

1. Capitalized Terms. Capitalized terms used, but not otherwise defined herein, shall have the meaning ascribed to such terms in the Existing ZLDA. 2.Amendment to the Existing ZLDA. Section 1(p) of the Existing ZLDA is hereby deleted and replaced with the following: "ReservedUnutilizedDevelopmentRights"shallmeanonethousandseventeen reservedandallocatedtotheOwnerParcel. 3. Amendment to the Existing ZLDA.Section 1(q) of the Existing ZLDA is hereby deleted and replaced with the following: “SubjectDevelopmentRights”shallmeanfivethousandtwohundredone(5,201) squarefeetof Development Rights appurtenant to the OwnerParcel (considered asifaseparatezoninglot).Notwithstandinganythingtothecontrary,theSubject DevelopmentRights shall include all Bonus Rights pertaining to the Combined Zoning Lot and the right to use the lot area of the Owner Land in calculating the Bonus Rights. Amendment to the Existing ZLDA. Section 2(d) of the Existing ZLDA is hereby deleted in its entirety, and replaced with the Architect's Certificate of Kohn Pedersen Fox Associates PC dated as of June 18, 2021 attached hereto and made a part hereof. 5. Potential Additional SubjectDevelopment Rights.Owner andDeveloper each acknowledge and agree that the square footage of the Subject Development Rights and the Reserved Unutilized Development Rights is based on the zoning floor area calculations prepared by Kohn Pederson Fox Associates PC dated March 26, 2021 (the “Zoning Calculations"), a copy of which is attached hereto as Exhibit C and made part hereof, which Zoning Calculations are part of a pending development application with DOB for the Developer's building. Developer may in the future desire or be required by DOB to utilize more square feet of unused Development Rights (it being understood that, in anticipation of such desire and/or requirement, the square footage being purchased as of the date hereof as part of the Subject Development Rights exceeds that set forth in the Zoning Calculations). If Developer desires or is required to utilize even more square feet of unused Development Rights, then Developer shall notify Owner in writing (the “Closing Notice") of the amount of Reserved Unutilized DevelopmentRights that Developerwould like to purchase from Owner and the date Developer would like to close, but in no event less than thirty (30) days from the date of the Closing Notice (the “Potential Closing"). The sale of the Reserved Unutilized Development Rights shall be on the same terms and conditions as the Purchase Agreement. In the event the Potential Closing occurs, Owner and Developer acknowledge and agree that Developer and Owner shall execute, acknowledge and cause to be recorded in the Register's Office, an amendment to the Existing ZLDA, as amend by this First Amendment ("Potential ZLDA Amendment") in form and substance reasonably acceptable to Owner and Developer.
